name: flyStart
meaning: collect-flight start: SetState(3) copies pos componentwise (0x496e29/37/45)

name: hudTarget
meaning: collect-flight target on the HUD, stored x/y/z by SetState(3) (0x496e71/87/8e)

name: flyPosition
meaning: lerp output of the collect flight, passed to SetPosition (address taken at 0x4970fb, 0x49716a)

name: flyT
meaning: flight parameter: movzx at 0x496fb1, incremented and stored at 0x497117

name: state
meaning: SetState stores its argument (0x496cda)

name: hudState
meaning: Update stores 5 on area entry (0x4966a7) and 6 on departure (0x496740)

name: scale
meaning: SetState(3) stores 0x1000 (0x496ded); Update compares signed and shrinks it; Render copies it three times

name: hudOffsetY
meaning: PostLoadInit stores 30; Update compares signed and adds/subtracts 4

name: hudFullBitmap
meaning: u32*: IdList_FindWithCount(0x9b); Update double-dereferences it before UiQuad_SetFromBitmap, the same pattern as the markerBitmap +0x58 of the level managers

name: hudEmptyBitmap
meaning: u32*: IdList_FindWithCount(0x9c), the same double dereference

name: chargeDuration
meaning: from the Ghost message 0x4005 at init; Update divides it by five (0x4965fd)

name: hudSlots
meaning: UiQuad[5]: UiQuad_SetFromBitmap((UiQuad*)(this+0x90+i*0x14)) for i<5; 0x90+5*0x14 = 0xf4 = master, so the extent is exact

name: master
meaning: MASTER property, or this when null; messages 0x4401/0x4403/0x4405 go to it

name: hoover
meaning: found by class 0x83 at init; HandleMessage sends it 0x4581/0x4582

name: ghost
meaning: found by class 0x78 at init; sent 0x4005

name: collected
meaning: message 0x4401 stores the sender at +0x100 + count*4 (0x496b36)

name: triggerBox
meaning: Box property at init; Update tests its XZ bounds

name: homePos
meaning: saved at init; Reset and SetState(2) pass its address to SetPosition (0x49656b, 0x496d70)

name: renderRot
meaning: copied to rot for rendering; StepCollectFlight updates the first component signed

name: isMaster
meaning: 1 when the MASTER property is null, else 0

name: reported
meaning: SetState(1) sends the collection notification once; cleared by reset/init

name: wolfInBox
meaning: latched XZ containment of the trigger box

name: charged
meaning: set by HandleMessage on the fifth battery

name: draining
meaning: argument of message 0x4404; gates the drain timer and collection

name: unknown138
meaning: Update writes 1 when not draining (0x49661a); role not established

name: collectedCount
meaning: movzx at 0x4965d7 and 0x496e58; message 0x4403 returns it

name: flySpin
meaning: SetState stores a derived angle; read signed by StepCollectFlight

name: drainTimer
meaning: Update subtracts g_dtMs and compares signed with 0 (0x4965b3)

name: soundHandle
meaning: SetState stores the Sound_Play handle (0x496de3); cleared by init/reset
